evidence.title: RECIPE CARD - EF-210 epoxy floor coating - Part A
evidence.claim: Earliest archived recipe revision containing the step is dated 2004-09-06.
evidence.quote: 6. Sieve quartz flour on 1 mm screen before charging.

evidence.title: CHANGE REQUEST CR-2003-010
evidence.claim: In 2003, sieving quartz flour was introduced to remove lumps caused by caked paper bags from supplier Silicati Brenta.
evidence.quote: Reason: lumps from caked Silicati Brenta paper bags (DR-2003-015).

evidence.title: DEVIATION REPORT DR-2003-015
evidence.claim: In 2003, grit and lumps were found in EF-210 due to wet quartz flour bags from Silicati Brenta.
evidence.quote: grit and lumps visible in the applied film. Cause: caked paper bags of quartz flour from Silicati Brenta

evidence.title: Maintenance log - vibrating screen VS-1 (extract)
evidence.claim: In 2024, the VS-1 screen continued to capture PE liner and cardboard debris from the quartz flour.
evidence.quote: Debris found on mesh: PE liner fragments, cardboard pieces.

evidence.title: Quality note QN-2018-009 - foreign matter retained by screen VS-1
evidence.claim: In 2018, the screen was confirmed as necessary to prevent PE liner fragments from causing nozzle blockages and film defects.
evidence.quote: keep the 1 mm screen as a foreign-matter barrier for big-bag deliveries.

evidence.title: Supplier qualification SQ-2010-003 - Quarzi Monterosso S.p.A.
evidence.claim: In 2010, Quarzi Monterosso replaced Silicati Brenta, switching from paper bags to big-bags with PE liners.
evidence.quote: Replaces Silicati Brenta paper bags from April 2010.

verdict.process_name: EF-210 epoxy floor coating, Part A
verdict.instruction: Sieve quartz flour through the 1 mm vibrating screen VS-1 before charging.
